## Summary

What changed, and why is the change needed?

## Scope

Which subsystem or specification area does this affect?

## Invariants

Which compiler or language invariants does this preserve, introduce, or strengthen?

## Design authority

- [ ] This change does not alter language semantics.
- [ ] This change alters language semantics and the governing specification/decision history is updated.
- [ ] This change alters syntax and its stability status is documented.
- [ ] The implementation does not silently establish a new language rule.

## Testing

- [ ] Project configures successfully.
- [ ] Project builds successfully.
- [ ] Complete CTest suite passes.
- [ ] `git diff --check` passes.
- [ ] New behavior has regression/conformance tests where practical.
- [ ] Invalid-input behavior is tested where relevant.

## Deferred work

List intentional follow-up work, related issues, or `None`.

## Notes for reviewers

Call out architectural tradeoffs, compatibility concerns, or areas requiring especially careful review.
